name: 私運弩手
prompt: Production 2D hand-painted fantasy RPG animation sprite atlas. SQUARE RGB OPAQUE PURE MAGENTA #FF00FF background, no alpha. EXACT 6 columns by 6 rows, thirty-six SEPARATE full-body miniature sprites. Same person, costume, weapon, scale and left-facing three-quarter view every frame. Each sprite no more than 65% cell width, generous 35px magenta gutters, NO touching neighbouring poses. No text, no grid lines, no scenery or floor. Adult anatomy, fine painterly details at 150px character height, NOT chibi, NOT 3D. SUBJECT: adult Chinese female smuggler with short black hair, brown hood thrown back, dark teal leather coat, grey trousers, belt pouches, a compact bamboo and steel crossbow gripped in both hands. ALL POSES FACE LEFT. SIX ROWS OF SIX POSES: idle breathing; attack (cocks crossbow, raises it, aims left and releases one short bolt, recoils and reloads, anticipation, contact, follow-through); hit recoil and recovery; guard using actual equipped weapon; evasive crouch step and recovery; falling defeated, final frame lies motionless. Full body including all weapon tips in each cell, completely separated poses. Pure solid opaque magenta RGB background, no transparency.
